gloss: to be granted, to be blessed with

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {授|さず}かっていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to be granted, to be given, to receive (from a superior or from heaven)
definitions.explanation: To receive something valuable from a person of higher status, or from a divine or fate-like source. Implies gratitude and humility.
To be blessed with a child. A respectful and joyful way to express the birth or conception of a child.

examples.japanese: ⟦{師匠|ししょう}→師匠：12421_shishou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{教|おし}え→教え：01909_oshie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{授|さず}かった。
examples.english: I received teachings from my master.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天|てん}→天：28464_ten⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{授|さず}かった⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活|い}かす→活かす：10422_ikasu⟧。
examples.english: To make use of a talent granted by heaven.

examples.japanese: ⟦{王|おう}→王：19353_ou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{名誉|めいよ}→名誉：10568_meiyo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧{称号|しょうごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{授|さず}かった。
examples.english: He was granted an honorable title by the king.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{授|さず}かった。
examples.english: We were blessed with a child.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{三年目|さんねんめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ようやく⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{授|さず}かった。
examples.english: Three years after getting married, we were finally blessed with a child.

examples.japanese: ⟦{待望|たいぼう}→待望：12545_taibou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{授|さず}かって、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}んでいる→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧。
examples.english: The whole family is overjoyed at being blessed with the long-awaited baby.

notes:
{授|さず}かる is the receiving counterpart of ⟦{授|さず}ける→授ける：10350_sazukeru⟧ (to grant, to bestow). It implies receiving something precious with humility and gratitude.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Counterpart: ⟦{授|さず}ける→授ける：10350_sazukeru⟧ (to grant, to bestow — the giving side)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{授|さず}かる: to receive ~ from ~
- ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{授|さず}かる: to be blessed with a child

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{授|さず}かる: to be given life
- ⟦{教|おし}え→教え：01909_oshie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{授|さず}かる: to receive teachings
- ⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{授|さず}かる: to be blessed with talent
- ⟦{子宝|こだから}→子宝：15103_kodakara⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{授|さず}かる: to be blessed with children

NOTE: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{授|さず}かる is the most common everyday use of this word. It is a respectful, warm way to announce a pregnancy or birth.
